long_description:
Celebrate Bollywood and Brazilian rhythms with live DJ music, dance performances, delicious food, and an open bar at this in-person banquet.

About this Event

Annual Banquet 2026 is an in-person cultural celebration for the general public, presented by the India Center of Westchester.

Music, Dance & Celebration
Enjoy Bollywood music with a live DJ, Brazilian dance performances, delicious food, an open bar, and an evening of friendship and cultural unity.

Event Details

Date: Saturday, November 21, 2026
Time: 5:30 PM
Venue: Castle Royale, 92 Waverly Street, Yonkers, NY 10701

Get your tickets: https://tinyurl.com/IcBanquet

India Center of Westchester brings communities together through culture and celebration.
